prompt_cn:
【道具资产图】16:9 横版设计稿，用于 AI 漫剧资产库
主体：未来主义能源步枪
材质：钛合金, 哑光黑阳极氧化面，导轨为磨砂钢
配色：哑光黑 + 磨砂钢原色
版式：左侧半身/头部特写（验五官与材质）；右侧正 / 严格 90° 侧 / 背 三视图
一致性：三视图必须同一角色，头身比 / 服装 / 装备 / 配色 / 材质完全一致
姿态：自然站立，双脚微开，双臂自然下垂，不做剧情动作
背景：纯白或极浅灰影棚背景，无环境叙事
光影：柔和均匀棚拍光，无强烈硬阴影，便于辨认材质
品质：8K 超清、拟真影视级概念设计稿质感
prompt_en:
Create a professional 16:9 landscape prop design sheet for a cinematic AI-animation / game production asset library.
PROP: 未来主义能源步枪
STRUCTURE: receiver, barrel, magazine, optic sight, grip, folding stock, CNC milled, anodised
MATERIALS: titanium alloy, matte black anodised finish, brushed-steel rails
WEAR: muzzle and ejection port worn through to brass, frayed grip wrap
COLOR: matte black and brushed-steel natural tone
SCALE: 92cm overall length, roughly a forearm
LAYOUT: Prop design sheet, 16:9, pure white background, seamless white studio background, left side: structure and material detail close-up, right side: multi-angle views — front, side, back, product photography lighting, soft even lighting, cinematic lighting quality, high detail, material accurate, no text, no logo, no watermark LEFT SIDE also carries a large hero view with mechanism close-up; RIGHT SIDE: front, strict 90-degree side, back.
CONSISTENCY: all views must show exactly the same prop with identical silhouette, dimensions, structural parts, colour, material, surface finish and wear. No hands, no usage scene, floating on neutral background.
BACKGROUND: pure white background or seamless white studio background, no environmental scene, no scenery, no props.
LIGHTING: soft even studio lighting, subtle ambient illumination, soft contact shadow, no harsh shadows, cinematic lighting quality — so that fabric, skin, metal and leather read clearly.
CINEMATIC QUALITY (concrete, not just the word 'cinematic'): controlled key light, soft fill, subtle rim light, physically plausible falloff, controlled contrast, cinematic depth, foreground / midground / background separation, restrained color palette, material separation
STYLE: ultra-detailed photorealistic hyper-detailed character design, professional game character design sheet. Quality targets: photorealistic / lifelike priority; ultra-high detail; 8K-level visual detail; cinematic lighting quality.
